family.description: Clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPRs) are a family of DNA direct repeats found in many prokaryotic genomes. This family of proteins corresponds to Cas1, a CRISPR-associated protein. Cas1 may be involved in linking DNA segments to CRISPR [[cite:PUB00043290]].
family.name: CRISPR associated protein Cas1

Later IHF/structural evidence and other members remain follow-up; IN_PROGRESS, no publication.

causal_graphs.context: MG1655 proteins with affinity tags removed; 33-bp M13-derived duplex and pUC19-based pCRISPR carrying the BL21-AI locus. Radiolabel default:200 nM complex,20 nM donor,approximately5 nM target;20 mM HEPES pH7.5,25 mM KCl,10 mM MgCl2,1 mM DTT,10%DMSO,37 C,1 h. EDTA/SDS/proteinase K treatment precedes gel analysis.

evidence.explanation: Original Figures1B-E and2B-C plus integration/radiolabel Methods; BandX exclusion and half-site interpretation come from the associated Results.

edges.mechanism: Joint WT proteins generate donor-containing plasmid products relative to component-omission controls. Retention of label after deproteinization and restriction digestion supports covalent integration, without assigning every band to a unique full-site product.
edges.subject: joint-reaction

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1E and ExtendedData3C; matched WT Cas2 and radiolabeled donor.

edges.mechanism: H208A loses detectable integration under the matched purified-protein protocol. This is a preparation-level substitution effect, not direct observation of histidine-mediated proton transfer.
edges.subject: h208a

evidence.explanation: Original ExtendedData3B/C, with active K224A comparison explicitly retained rather than treating all displayed variants as inactive.

edges.mechanism: D221A lowers the donor-containing product to undetectable levels in this gel assay. Neither protein-folding equivalence nor an individual metal-coordination microstep is established by that endpoint.
edges.subject: d221a

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1C/E; Cas2 E9Q remains active in the same comparison.

edges.mechanism: The partner deletion loses detectable donor incorporation with WT Cas1. The perturbation removes a Cas2 interaction region; it is not a mutation inside PF01867 or proof that Cas2 nuclease chemistry is required.
edges.subject: cas2-deletion

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Cas1 Q46896 sequence version1 equals NP_417235.1 and PDB4P6I entity2,305 aa. Current PF01867 match131-226 includes H208 and D221. Cas2 is a separate partner, not another PF01867 domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Joint preparation/substrate conditions, not isolated-domain sufficiency. Radiolabeled relaxed/linear bands do not uniquely prove full-site insertion or completed chromosomal repair; half-site events predominate. BandX is not labeled donor-containing product. Mutant losses do not alone identify an elementary catalytic step. Cas1 K224A and Cas2 E9Q retain activity.

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2015 Figures1B-E/2B-C and ExtendedData3, preparation-level integration and mutant comparisons.
causal_graphs.title: Purified Cas1-Cas2 integrates donor DNA into supercoiled pCRISPR

causal_graphs.context: Same donor/pCRISPR radiolabel assay,10 mM MnCl2 replacing MgCl2;0/50/100/200 nM protein series,37 C,1 h. Compare Cas1 alone with Cas1 plus Cas2 at the corresponding series positions.

evidence.explanation: Original ExtendedData2B and associated main-text statement; Cas2-alone and no-protein controls inspected.

edges.mechanism: Product bands are stronger with both proteins than with Cas1 alone. This records partner-dependent enhancement in Mn without converting the low baseline into zero activity.
edges.subject: add-cas2

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Intact MG1655 Cas1 Q46896/NP_417235.1; PF01867 131-226. No isolated-domain or other-member experiment.
causal_graphs.limitations: Qualitative representative gels, not measured fold stimulation. Low Cas1-alone activity prevents an absolute Cas2 requirement claim. The Mg condition is a separate comparison, not pooled with Mn.

nodes.label: Add Cas2 to the Cas1 donor-target reaction in manganese
Radiolabeled donor-containing plasmid product

causal_graphs.title: Cas2 enhances the low Cas1-alone integration signal in manganese

causal_graphs.context: WT Cas1-Cas2, Mg radiolabel integration protocol at37 C for1 h; each altered substrate compared with the matched33-bp duplex/supercoiled pCRISPR control. No IHF is supplied.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3A/B dual-capped donor versus hydroxyl-ended duplex; Methods uses phosphatase-minus kinase for labeled3prime-phosphorylated substrates.

edges.mechanism: Blocking both3prime hydroxyls removes detectable integration, supporting the end-chemistry requirement in this reaction. The endpoint does not directly image the nucleophilic transition state.
edges.subject: cap-both-ends

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3A/B separate S1-only and S2-only lanes with and without Cas1-Cas2.

edges.mechanism: Neither isolated donor strand yields the product seen with the annealed duplex. This is a substrate-state comparison, not proof that every Cas1 homolog rejects all single-stranded donors.
edges.subject: single-strand

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3C directly compares supercoiled and linear pCRISPR; the separate1-kb fragment and empty-vector results prevent sequence-requirement overstatement.

edges.mechanism: Linear pCRISPR lacks detectable incorporation under the tested IHF-absent conditions. Later host-factor-supported integration into linear DNA bounds this negative; it is not a universal physical prerequisite for Cas1.
edges.subject: linearize-target

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Intact MG1655 Cas1 Q46896/NP_417235.1, PF01867 131-226, acting with Cas2. DNA perturbations do not establish isolated-domain sufficiency.
causal_graphs.limitations: Three separate experiments, not a combined perturbation. Dual3prime capping differs from single-end capping;5prime phosphorylation is compatible. Later PMID27211867 establishes an IHF-dependent linear-DNA context, so topology dependence is not universal. Empty supercoiled pUC19 also supports integration.

Supply donor strand S1 or S2 alone, each separately
Replace supercoiled pCRISPR with linear pCRISPR
Radiolabeled donor-containing target product

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2015 Figure3A-C, three separate substrate comparisons.
causal_graphs.title: Donor-end chemistry and target topology alter the IHF-absent reaction

causal_graphs.context: 50 nM purified Cas1 with5 nM synthetic radiolabeled Y-DNA; integration buffer containing10 mM MgCl2 or MnCl2,37 C,1 h; native15%polyacrylamide electrophoresis.

evidence.explanation: Correctly matched original main Figure2H and synthetic-substrate Methods, not the incorrectly linked ED5 image.

edges.mechanism: Cas1 alone generates the donor-sized product in both tested metal conditions, relative to no-protein and Cas2-only controls. This preparation-level disintegration observation does not resolve every chemical microstep or minor product.
edges.subject: cas1-y-dna

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Intact Q46896/NP_417235.1 Cas1, PF01867 131-226; the synthetic substrate mimics a half-site intermediate but was not recovered from the integration assay.
causal_graphs.limitations: Cas2 is optional and Cas2 alone is inactive. This is not proof that BandX in the separate plasmid reaction necessarily arose through this route. The original ED5 target-rejoining image is unresolved because of a PMC image/caption mismatch; no separate rejoining edge is claimed.

Released radiolabeled 33-bp donor-sized duplex

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2015 Figure2G/H, Cas1-alone preparation in two separately tested metal conditions.
causal_graphs.title: Cas1 releases a donor-sized duplex from synthetic Y-DNA

causal_graphs.context: MG1655 cas1/cas2 on pCDF-1b in BL21-AI; LB,50 ug/ml streptomycin,0.2%arabinose,0.1 mM IPTG,20-24 h induction. OD600-normalized cellular input and CRISPR-I PCR/agarose readout.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1B and Online Methods; induced/uninduced and individual-component controls inspected.

edges.mechanism: Expanded bands appear with joint expression, unlike Cas1-only, Cas2-only or empty-vector controls. This phenotype includes host activities needed after initial integration and is not joined to the purified endpoint as a directly traced pathway.
edges.subject: coexpress-cas1-cas2

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Donor Cas1 Q46896/NP_417235.1,305 aa,PF01867 131-226. Taxon identifies the K12 donor reference, not BL21-AI as an identical strain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Whole-cell joint-expression effect, not purified Cas1 sufficiency or an isolated-domain experiment. PCR expansion and reported clonal sequencing do not establish protection against phage. No raw sequencing reanalysis or SupplementaryTable1 review is claimed.

nodes.label: Induce both Cas1 and Cas2 in BL21-AI
Expanded CRISPR-I locus PCR bands

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2014 Figure1B, heterologous whole-cell acquisition assay.
causal_graphs.title: Joint Cas1-Cas2 expression expands the cellular CRISPR locus

causal_graphs.context: BL21-AI pCDF-1b acquisition assay after20-24 h induction, matched WT coexpression control and OD600-normalized CRISPR-I PCR; at least three assay repetitions.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure4C lane labels and Online Methods; the readout is cellular locus expansion, not direct nuclease activity.

edges.mechanism: Each of the four variants loses detectable expanded bands under the cellular protocol. The grouped node records four separately tested effects without claiming equal quantitative impairment or a shared demonstrated chemical defect.
edges.subject: four-single-variants

evidence.explanation: Original Figure4C K224A lane; contrasted explicitly with PMID25707795 ExtendedData3 rather than suppressing either result.

edges.mechanism: K224A lacks detectable expanded bands here despite its retained integration in the later purified assay. The unresolved context dependence prevents labeling the mutant universally catalytically inactive.
edges.subject: k224a

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q46896/NP_417235.1 reference E141,H208,D218,D221,K224 verified; all lie within current PF01867 131-226. Intact proteins, not purified isolated domains.
causal_graphs.limitations: Each variant is a separate single substitution, not a combined mutant. Loss of a cellular endpoint does not prove loss of chemistry. K224A retains purified integration in2015 ED3; abundance, folding and host-dependent steps remain alternatives.

nodes.label: Cas1 E141A, H208A, D218A or D221A, each separately
Cas1 K224A with WT Cas2
Expanded CRISPR-I PCR bands relative to WT

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2014 Figure4C, separately tested Cas1 single substitutions with WT Cas2.
causal_graphs.title: In-domain Cas1 substitutions reduce cellular locus expansion

causal_graphs.context: BL21-AI cellular acquisition protocol, each Cas1 variant coexpressed with WT Cas2 and compared with WT Cas1/Cas2;20-24 h induction and normalized CRISPR-I PCR.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3D charged/alanine/WT comparisons and associated Results; tail-deletion and I291 variants in Figure3C retain activity.

edges.mechanism: Each charge-reversal variant gives little or no expanded product compared with WT. The result does not prove that every substitution at these positions, or every PF01867 member, has the same defect.
edges.subject: interface-single-variants

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Reference Q46896/NP_417235.1 R245,R252,R256 verified but outside PF01867 131-226. These effects belong to the intact family-bearing protein, not directly to the annotated interval.
causal_graphs.limitations: Corresponding alanine substitutions retain acquisition. The three charge substitutions are not a triple mutant. WT-like SEC retention was reported for R252E only and does not establish normal folding of all variants; original supplement remains uninspected.

nodes.label: Cas1 R245D, R252E or R256E, each separately
Expanded CRISPR-I PCR bands relative to WT

causal_graphs.scope: Nunez2014 Figure3D, three independently tested single variants.
causal_graphs.title: Outside-match Cas1 charge substitutions reduce locus expansion

causal_graphs.context: BL21-AI coexpressing Cas1-FLAG and Cas2-HA; normalized lysate input,anti-FLAG resin,400 mM KCl washes and anti-HA blotting. Compare R252E with WT Cas1.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3F input and immunoprecipitate panels plus IP Methods; no equivalent co-IP result is assigned to R245D or R256E.

edges.mechanism: Cas2-HA recovery is strongly reduced despite its detection in the input. This is a mutation-dependent lysate association readout; it does not establish the entire mechanistic route from residue charge to immunity.
edges.subject: r252e

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q46896/NP_417235.1 R252 lies outside PF01867 131-226. Epitope-tagged intact protein in cell lysate, not isolated domain or tag-cleaved purified complex.
causal_graphs.limitations: Co-isolation is not a purified affinity measurement or a direct activation step. Input controls do not eliminate every abundance/folding/complex-stability alternative. No observed causal arrow joins reduced co-isolation to the separate acquisition phenotype.
